Signed, Sealed, Delivered, Hartland Back on Top
item.guid: news-2026-04-26-Signed, Sealed, Delivered, Hartland Back on Top
item.description: State champions again. Dylan "Qyxical" Reinwand and Tavin "TRE4TY" Flanagan won the MiHSEF Spring 2026 Rocket League title at UM-Flint, beating Godwin Heights 4-2. The turning point was Flanagan's goal-line save and coast-to-coast overtime winner in Game 5.

item.guid: news-2026-03-04-Hartland Rocket League Star Dylan Reinwand Signs with Cleary University
item.description: Senior Dylan "Qyxical" Reinwand has signed with Cleary University. The Fall 2024 state champion and All-State selection also led Hartland to a Top 5 finish at the PlayVS Cup nationals.

Hartland Esports Sends Teams to 2025 State Championship LAN
item.guid: news-2025-11-25-Hartland Esports Sends Teams to 2025 State Championship LAN
item.description: Two Hartland teams reached the MHSEL Elite Eight in Fall 2025. Super Smash Bros. edged Belleville 3-2, and a freshman Fortnite duo swept Melvindale, sending both to the State Championship LAN at Michigan State. Elka Borreson and Jeffery Howe earned All-State honors.

Eagles Soar to National Elite Eight in 2025 PlayVS Cup
item.guid: news-2025-05-29-Eagles Soar to National Elite Eight in 2025 PlayVS Cup
item.description: Top 5 in the nation. Hartland's Rocket League team beat teams from Massachusetts and Arkansas to reach the Elite Eight of the 2025 PlayVS Cup and placed Top 5 in the final national rankings, out of more than 1,100 teams.

item.title: Hartland High School Esports Team Wins State Championship
item.guid: news-2024-12-09-Hartland High School Esports Team Wins State Championship
item.description: State champions. The #3 seed Hartland Eagles won the Fall 2024 Rocket League state title at Michigan State, erasing a 3-1 deficit to beat undefeated #1 Rochester in Game 7 and earning a bid to the 2025 PlayVS Cup.

item.title: Hartland Esports Captures Fall 2024 Rocket League State Championship in Thrilling Fashion
item.guid: news-2024-12-09-Hartland Esports Captures Fall 2024 Rocket League State Championship in Thrilling Fashion
item.description: State champions. The #3 seed Hartland Eagles won the program's first MHSEL Rocket League title at Michigan State, erasing a 3-1 deficit to beat undefeated #1 Rochester in Game 7 and earning a bid to the 2025 PlayVS Cup.

item.title: Army's Esports Semi to Visit Hartland High School
item.guid: news-2024-10-21-Army's Esports Semi to Visit Hartland High School
item.description: The U.S. Army's esports trailer rolled into Hartland High School, joined by players from Eastern Michigan and Oakland University. Coach Cameron Montney highlighted what the program offers beyond gameplay: teamwork, college scholarships, and student-run streaming, shoutcasting, and graphic design.

item.title: Hartland Eagles Soar at First MEC x SMC Fiber Cup
item.guid: news-2024-01-05-Hartland Eagles Soar at First MEC x SMC Fiber Cup
item.description: In their first year as a club, the Hartland Eagles traveled across the state and won the inaugural MEC x SMC Fiber Cup, topping a 15-team Rocket League field at Southwestern Michigan College in the team's first live-audience event.

item.title: Hartland E-Sports Team Competes In Semi-Finals In First Season
item.guid: news-2023-12-23-Hartland E-Sports Team Competes In Semi-Finals In First Season
item.description: State runner-up in its first-ever season. Hartland's Rocket League team beat perennial powers Divine Child and Detroit Catholic Central to reach the Fall 2023 MHSEL title match at Oakland University, and its players drew interest from college programs.
